claims.claim: Los Suns was first worn May 5, 2010 against San Antonio as the club's stand against SB 1070.

sources.title: Viva Los Suns: Phoenix Suns Denounce SB 1070 [VIDEO]
the nation here come los suns against the bill

claims.evidence: The Suns wore Los Suns for Game 2 of the 2010 West semifinals against the Spurs in Phoenix on Cinco de Mayo to protest SB 1070. But the jerseys were not new: they were made for Noche Latina and had been worn twice that regular season. So May 5, 2010 was the protest game, not the first wearing.
